# 零界演化

> SingularityX Evolution follows AI4S → RSI → AI4S, starting with intelligent financial decision-making to explore multi-agent collaboration and self-evolution, alongside an open human–AI organization with verifiable contributions and explainable allocation.

## Canonical identity
- Website name: 零界演化
- Chinese name: 零界演化
- English name: SingularityX Evolution
- Official website: https://singularity-x.ai/
- Official GitHub: https://github.com/SingularityX-Evolution
- Official recruitment email: join@singularityx.tech
- Official WeChat public account: 零界演化
- Public collaboration locations: Hangzhou, Qingdao, Shenzhen, Hong Kong, Singapore
- Participation: full-time, internships, collaboration tasks; office city unrestricted; remote supported

## Research and organization
- Motto: AGENT FIRST
- Research path: AI4S → RSI → AI4S
- Starting point: intelligent financial decision systems
- Technical approaches: world models, multi-agent mechanisms, reinforcement learning, evolutionary dynamics and other methods are candidates for exploration. Technical approaches, system architectures and evolution processes will be revised based on research progress and reproducible experimental evidence.
- Organization: exploring open human–AI collaboration, verifiable contributions, value assessment, explainable allocation and an appeals process
- Autonomy: paired with independent validation, AI red teaming and defense, traceable decisions and risk control
- Long-term interests: scientific research, humans and AI learning together, and AI–neuroscience intersections
- Full organization introduction: https://singularity-x.ai/organization/

## S2E collaboration platform
- Chinese introduction: https://singularity-x.ai/s2e/
- English introduction: https://singularity-x.ai/en/s2e/
- S2E (Singularity to Evolution) is a distributed AI collaboration platform in development, presented separately from the company identity.
- It connects researchers, experts, engineers, agents and computing resources through verifiable research tasks.
- Long-term questions concern energy and habitats, life and intelligence, and collaboration and civilization.
- Current stage: a small-sample finance demo to refine task collaboration, outcome validation and contribution records. Other scientific fields are long-term directions.
- Guided by public-interest research and community collaboration; contribution records, controlled sharing and participation support mechanisms are under exploration.
